text:
@Kristennetten While it is tempting to focus on one of those arenas as the “hard one”, in fact they are all difficult & important. Tight C & custom compiler too.

An inference computer optimized for energy efficiency, reliability & long life is also critical. Can’t just jam GPUs in the trunk.

author: elonmusk
text:
@Kristennetten A general solution to self-driving (essentially, real-world AI) requires writing extremely difficult software in the arenas of training, inference, control, analytical tools, data management, hardware optimization & simulation.

One of the hardest technology problems that exists.
